title_sq: 2 Apartamente 1+1 ne shitje 21 Dhjetori ne Tirane
description_sq:
Tek kryqezimi i 21 Dhjetorit, prane klinikes Diamond Dental, shiten 2 apartamente 1+1 me siperfaqe 65 m2, kati i 5, pallat egzistues. Organizohen nga korridori shperndares, soxhorno, dhome gjumi, tualet dhe ballkon. Apartamentet jane totalisht te restauruar nga e para duke filluar nga instalime elektrike, hidraulike, dyer, dritare, parket etj. Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor. Ideale per air bnb. Shiten te dyja bashke, jo tek e tek.
Shitet 193000 Euro
title_en: 2 Apartments 1+1 for sale December 21 in Tirana
description_en: At the intersection of 21 December, near the Diamond Dental clinic, 2 1+1 apartments with a surface area of ​​65 m2 are for sale, 5th floor, existing building. They are organized by the distribution corridor, living room, bedroom, toilet and balcony. The apartments are completely restored from scratch, starting with electrical, plumbing, doors, windows, parquet, etc. Has regular mortgage documentation. Ideal for air bnb. Both are sold together, not separately. For sale 193000 Euro
